description: Stable format-independent diagnostics raised by shared validation and USD authoring. Codes are <PREFIX>-<E|W><NNN>, never renumbered or reused; messages may be reworded. Every message starts with its bracketed code, e.g. "[RN-W201] ...". See docs/reference/DIAGNOSTICS.md.

diagnostics.summary: A road, junction, or junction connection has an empty ID.
diagnostics.action: Give the element a non-empty ID in the source file.

diagnostics.summary: A road or junction ID is not unique within its kind, or a connection ID is not unique within its junction.
diagnostics.action: Rename one of the elements so that each ID is unique.

diagnostics.summary: A road's predecessor or successor names a road or junction that does not exist.
diagnostics.action: Correct the link target, or add the missing road or junction.

diagnostics.summary: A road belongs to a junction that does not exist.
diagnostics.action: Correct the road's junction ID, or add the junction.

diagnostics.summary: A junction connection names an incoming or connecting road that does not exist.
diagnostics.action: Correct the connection's road IDs, or add the missing road.

diagnostics.summary: A junction connection's connecting road does not belong to that junction.
diagnostics.action: Set the connecting road's junction to the junction that lists the connection.

diagnostics.summary: A lane link names a lane that does not exist: an unknown road, a lane section index out of range, or a lane number the section does not have.
diagnostics.action: Correct the lane link or the road link it is derived from.

diagnostics.summary: A lane section does not have exactly one center lane.
diagnostics.action: Give every lane section exactly one lane numbered 0.

diagnostics.summary: The left lanes of a lane section are not numbered 1..n, or its right lanes -1..-m, without gaps or repeats.
diagnostics.action: Renumber the lanes of the section outward from the center lane.

diagnostics.summary: A numeric value is not finite (NaN or infinite).
diagnostics.action: Replace the value with a finite number.

diagnostics.summary: A road or plan-view segment length is not positive.
diagnostics.action: Give the road and each plan-view segment a positive length.

diagnostics.summary: The plan-view segments do not cover the road: the first does not start at s = 0, one does not start where the previous ends, or the last does not end at the road length (tolerance 1e-6 m).
diagnostics.action: Correct the segment s values and lengths, or the road length.

diagnostics.summary: A road has no lane section, its first lane section does not start at s = 0 (tolerance 1e-6 m), or the lane-section s values do not ascend strictly.
diagnostics.action: Order the lane sections by strictly increasing s, starting at 0.

diagnostics.summary: A plan-view segment starts more than 0.01 m from the end of the previous segment.
diagnostics.action: Correct the segment's start position so that the reference line is continuous.

diagnostics.summary: A plan-view segment starts with a heading more than 0.001 rad from the end heading of the previous segment.
diagnostics.action: Correct the segment's start heading so that the reference line is tangent-continuous.

diagnostics.summary: The records of an elevation, lane-offset, or lane-width profile do not ascend strictly in their start s.
diagnostics.action: Order the records by strictly increasing s, and remove records that repeat an s value.

diagnostics.summary: A lane border on the inside of an arc reaches or passes the arc's center of curvature, so the border would fold back on itself.
diagnostics.action: Reduce the lane offset or lane widths on the inside of the arc, or increase the arc's radius.
